title: ViewStruct: View-Grounded Articulation and Connectivity Inference
title_zh: ViewStruct：基于视图的关节与连接性推理

paragraphs.en: Interacting with unfamiliar objects requires understanding how their parts connect and move. We introduce ViewStruct, a framework for jointly predicting connectivity and articulation in objects and scenes. Given an RGB image with aligned part segmentation and depth, optionally supplemented by images or video, ViewStruct predicts rigid-body groupings, attachments, and joint parameters. Its view-grounded representation links predictions to observed regions and expresses joint geometry in a gravity-aligned, view-relative frame, without requiring category-specific canonical orientations. A pretrained vision–language model is adapted to predict structure in seconds, without requiring observed articulation motion or per-instance optimisation. Experiments demonstrate improved structural prediction over evaluated baselines and transfer to unseen categories, asset sources, and real-world human-interaction videos, despite task-specific training exclusively on synthetic data. Simulated manipulation experiments further demonstrate the utility of predicted joints for generating robot motion trajectories. Project page: https://bianwenjing.github.io/viewstruct/
paragraphs.zh: 与不熟悉物体的互动需要理解其各部分如何连接和运动。 我们提出了 ViewStruct，一个用于联合预测物体和场景中连接性与关节结构的框架。 给定一张包含对齐的部件分割和深度信息的 RGB 图像（可选地辅以其他图像或视频），ViewStruct 能够预测刚体分组、附着关系和关节参数。 其基于视角的表示方法将预测结果与观测区域关联起来，并以重力对齐、视角相关的坐标系表达关节几何结构，无需依赖类别特定的标准朝向。 一个预训练的视觉-语言模型经过调整，可在数秒内预测结构，且不需要观测到关节运动或对每个实例进行优化。 实验表明，尽管任务训练完全基于合成数据，该方法在结构预测方面优于所评估的基线模型，并能迁移到未见过的类别、资产来源以及真实世界中的人类互动视频。 模拟操作实验进一步证明了预测关节在生成机器人运动轨迹方面的实用性。 项目页面：https://bianwenjing.github.io/viewstruct/

paragraphs.en: Robots interacting with unfamiliar environments must understand which parts move together and which motions their connections permit. These constraints inform manipulation planning and the construction of interactive representations from visual observations. Geometry and segmentation alone do not establish them: a drawer front, handle, and box may occupy separate regions yet move as one rigid body, while adjacent cabinet doors may move independently. In scenes, this reasoning must also distinguish mechanical attachments from proximity between unrelated objects.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人与陌生环境互动时，必须理解哪些部分会协同移动，以及各连接处允许怎样的运动。 这些约束条件为操作规划以及从视觉观察中构建交互表示提供了依据。 仅凭几何形状和分割无法确定这些关系：一个抽屉的前板、把手和箱体可能占据不同区域，却作为一个刚体共同移动；而相邻的柜门则可能各自独立运动。 在场景中，这种推理还必须能够区分机械连接与无关物体之间的空间邻近关系。

paragraphs.en: Practical structural understanding requires flexible inputs and efficient inference. A single image provides appearance and spatial cues but may leave motion constraints ambiguous. Additional views reveal more structure, while video provides evidence of shared and relative motion. A useful predictor should accommodate these observations without requiring every movable part to be seen in action, and produce estimates quickly enough to inform subsequent interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 实用的结构理解需要灵活的输入和高效的推理。 单张图像能提供外观和空间线索，但可能使运动约束变得模糊不清。 更多视角能揭示更多结构，而视频则提供了共享运动和相对运动的证据。 一个有效的预测模型应能适应这些观察结果，无需看到每个可移动部件的实际动作，并能足够快速地生成估计值以指导后续交互。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods address these settings through different routes. OPD ( Jiang et al., 2022a ) and OPDMulti ( Sun et al., 2024 ) estimate openable-part motion from single-view images. SINGAPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and PhysX-Anything ( Cao et al., 2025 ) generate articulated assets from images, while Particulate ( Li et al., 2026a ) infers articulation from geometry. Interaction-based methods such as ArtiPoint ( Werby et al., 2025 ) and MoMa-SG ( Buechner et al., 2026 ) recover articulation from observed motion. These methods typically target a particular observation setting, such as single-image prediction or estimation from observed motion. We instead use one predictor and output representation across static images and interaction sequences, allowing additional observations to refine the estimate without making motion a prerequisite.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过不同途径处理这些设置。 OPD（Jiang 等人，2022a）和 OPDMulti（Sun 等人，2024）根据单视角图像估算可开启部分的运动。 SINGAPO（Liu 等人，2025）和 PhysX-Anything（Cao 等人，2025）从图像中生成可活动资产，而 Particulate（Li 等人，2026a）则通过几何结构推断出关节活动。 基于交互的方法，如 ArtiPoint（Werby 等人，2025）和 MoMa-SG（Buechner 等人，2026），从观察到的运动中恢复关节活动。 这些方法通常针对特定的观察设置，例如单图像预测或根据观察到的运动进行估算。 我们则使用一个预测器和输出表示来同时处理静态图像和交互序列，从而允许通过额外观察来优化估算结果，而无需将运动作为前提条件。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ViewStruct , a VLM-based framework taking a reference RGB image with aligned part segmentation and depth, optionally supplemented by images or video. The reference observation determines the part identities and output coordinate frame. Input regions need not correspond to rigid bodies: the model predicts which regions move together and how these bodies attach. By adapting a pretrained VLM, ViewStruct combines knowledge of part functions and plausible mechanical relationships with observation-specific evidence, predicting structure in seconds without per-instance optimisation or an external refinement loop.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ViewStruct，一个基于 VLM 的框架，它接收一张参考 RGB 图像，其中包含对齐的部件分割和深度信息，并可选择性地辅以其他图像或视频。 参考观测决定了各部件的身份以及输出的坐标框架。 输入区域不必对应于刚体：模型会预测哪些区域会协同移动，以及这些物体如何相互连接。 通过适配一个预训练的 VLM，ViewStruct 将关于部件功能及合理机械关系的知识与特定观测的证据相结合，能够在数秒内预测结构，而无需针对每个实例进行优化或使用外部精修循环。

paragraphs.en: Our view-grounded representation associates predictions with observed regions through persistent part identifiers. Joint geometry is expressed in a gravity-aligned, view-relative frame, avoiding category-specific canonical orientations while stabilising the vertical direction across viewpoints. Revolute pivots are decoded from image locations and relative depth, providing explicit image correspondence. This representation applies consistently to individual objects and multi-object scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的基于视角的表示通过持久的部件标识符将预测与观测区域关联起来。 联合几何结构以与重力对齐且相对于视角的坐标系来表示，既避免了类别特定的规范朝向，又能在不同视角间保持垂直方向的一致性。 旋转枢轴从图像位置和相对深度中解码出来，从而提供明确的图像对应关系。 这种表示方法能一致地应用于单个物体和多物体场景。

paragraphs.en: Experiments demonstrate improved connectivity and articulation prediction over evaluated baselines, including transfer to held-out categories and unseen asset sources. Despite task-specific training exclusively on synthetic data, ViewStruct also transfers to real-world human-interaction videos, where motion evidence improves joint classification and localisation. We further use predicted joints to generate manipulation trajectories in simulation, testing them against reference object mechanisms under assisted contact.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，与所评估的基线方法相比，该方法在连接性和关节预测方面表现更佳，包括对预留类别和未见过的资产来源的迁移能力。 尽管 ViewStruct 仅基于合成数据进行了任务特定的训练，但它也能迁移到真实世界中的人机互动视频，在这些视频中，运动证据能够提升关节的分类与定位准确性。 我们进一步利用预测出的关节在模拟环境中生成操作轨迹，并在辅助接触条件下将其与参考对象机制进行对比测试。

paragraphs.en: We summarise our contributions as follows: First , we formulate joint connectivity and articulation inference using a shared view-grounded representation for objects and scenes. Second , we develop ViewStruct, supporting single-image, multi-image, and video inputs with inference in seconds and no requirement for observed articulation motion. Third , we demonstrate improved structural prediction, generalisation across categories and observation domains, and utility for robotic manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：首先，我们利用基于共享视角的物体和场景表示，对联合连通性和关节运动进行推理。 其次，我们开发了 ViewStruct，支持单图像、多图像和视频输入，推理过程仅需数秒，且无需观测到关节运动。 第三，我们展示了其在结构预测、跨类别和观测领域的泛化能力，以及其在机器人操作中的实用性方面的提升。

paragraphs.en: Prior work estimates articulation from static observations ( Hu et al., 2017 ; Zeng et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2020 ) , including single-view openable-part detection in objects and scenes ( Jiang et al., 2022a ; Sun et al., 2024 ) . Other methods construct articulated assets from graphs ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , images ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) , or meshes ( Li et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ) , or infer articulation through synthesised motion ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . ViewStruct jointly predicts mechanical connectivity and articulation over supplied regions, using a shared view-grounded representation for objects and scenes without category-specific canonical orientations.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究通过静态观察来估计可活动结构（Hu et al., 2017; Zeng et al., 2021; Li et al., 2020），包括对物体和场景中单视角可开启部分的检测（Jiang et al., 2022a; Sun et al., 2024）。 其他方法则通过图（Liu et al., 2024）、图像（Chen et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2025; Cao et al., 2025; Cao et al., 2026）或网格（Li et al., 2026a; Li et al., 2026b）构建可活动资产，或通过合成的运动推断可活动结构（Lee et al., 2026）。 ViewStruct 联合预测给定区域上的机械连接关系和可活动结构，它使用一种共享的基于视角的表示来描述物体和场景，而无需针对特定类别定义标准朝向。

paragraphs.en: Motion-based approaches recover articulation from multiple observed states ( Jiang et al., 2022b ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Weng et al., 2024 ) , including through active interaction in scenes ( Hsu et al., 2023 ) . ArtiPoint ( Werby et al., 2025 ) estimates articulation through tracking and optimisation, while Pandora ( Yu et al., 2026 ) and MoMa-SG ( Buechner et al., 2026 ) incorporate interaction-derived articulation into scene graphs. paragraphs.en: We convert annotated articulated assets from different sources into a common set of observation-grounded input–target pairs. Fixed attachments are grouped into rigid bodies, and scene examples additionally record object membership. paragraphs.en: To improve robustness to different test-time segmenters, we also vary the supplied part decomposition. We either split an articulated part by a plane through its centroid into two rigidly connected regions sharing the original joint, or merge two sibling regions with compatible articulation. We then update the part inventory and re-render the segmentation map S S , preserving the joint parameters and underlying kinematics. This exposes the model to different visual decompositions of the same mechanical structure, reducing dependence on a particular segmentation. Ablations demonstrate improved prediction performance ( Section C.2 ). Corpus construction and augmentation details are provided in Sections A.3 and A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了提升模型对测试时不同分割器的鲁棒性，我们还改变了所提供的部件分解方式。 我们要么通过穿过其质心的平面将一个可活动部件分割为两个刚性连接的区域，这两个区域共享原始关节；要么将两个具有兼容活动关系的子区域合并。 接着，我们更新部件清单并重新渲染分割图 S S，同时保留关节参数和底层的运动学关系。 这使得模型能够接触到同一机械结构的不同视觉分解方式，从而降低对特定分割方式的依赖。 消融实验表明预测性能得到了提升（C.2 节）。 语料库构建与增强细节见 A.3 和 A.2 节。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate all methods on 387 387 objects from the PhysX-Mobility ( Cao et al., 2025 ) test split, using ViewStruct with either ground-truth depth or monocular depth estimated by MoGe ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . As shown in Table 1 , ViewStruct achieves the highest joint F 1 F_{1} , while also predicting part connectivity. PhysX-Omni achieves higher type and axis accuracy and matched-joint success ( 85.3 % 85.3\% versus 81.5 % 81.5\% ). However, these conditional metrics exclude unrecovered joints and should therefore be interpreted alongside coverage. Canonical-coordinate prediction also benefits from axis-alignment priors in this dataset, whereas ViewStruct expresses joint directions relative to the observation. When evaluated over all reference joints, ViewStruct achieves 78.2 % 78.2\% success, compared with 66.6 % 66.6\% for PhysX-Omni, with the advantage largely retained using estimated depth. Inference takes 6.5 6.5 s per object, compared with 241 241 – 267 267 s for the VLM-based joint prediction stages of PhysX-Omni and PhysX-Anything, excluding their geometry-generation time.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 2 , ViewStruct recovers 94.7 % 94.7\% of reference joints, compared with 15.7 % 15.7\% for OPDMulti and 30.3 % 30.3\% for PhysX-Omni. It also achieves higher type and axis accuracy and lower pivot error on matched joints. Although matched-joint success remains limited at 26.2 % 26.2\% , its substantially higher coverage yields 24.8 % 24.8\% success over all reference joints, compared with 1.8 % 1.8\% and 7.4 % 7.4\% for the baselines. These results highlight the importance of evaluating both joint recovery and parameter accuracy. The last row of Table 2 supplies additional evidence at test time: two further renderings of the same room, one from the same viewpoint and one from a second viewpoint, with the articulated parts moved. Joint recovery is already saturated and does not change, while type and axis accuracy improve ( 77.6 → 80.5 77.6\rightarrow 80.5 and 62.1 → 64.4 62.1\rightarrow 64.4 ) and success over all reference joints rises from 24.8 % 24.8\% to 26.6 % 26.6\% . The hinge pivot is unaffected ( 0.331 → 0.337 0.331\rightarrow 0.337 ), consistent with it remaining the dominant error. Figure 5 illustrates recovered structures and a joint-type error; detailed protocols and in-frame diagnostics are provided in the supplementary.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on 242 242 objects from SimReady ( Lightwheel, 2025 ) , an unseen asset source, and 291 291 objects from GRScenes ( Wang et al., 2024 ) spanning seven categories held out from its training partition. Split construction and input protocols are detailed in Appendix B . As shown in Table 3 , ViewStruct achieves stronger generalisation to unseen asset sources and object categories than the baselines, recovering more joints while accurately predicting the type, axis, pivot, and range of matched joints. Since it recovers nearly all reference joints, its two success rates almost coincide ( 33.3 % 33.3\% and 31.5 % 31.5\% on SimReady, 48.7 % 48.7\% and 48.5 % 48.5\% on the held-out categories), whereas the generative baselines lose more than half of their matched-joint rate once missed joints are counted.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ViewStruct on 342 342 human interactions from Arti4D ( Werby et al., 2025 ) without additional training. The model receives an initial RGB-D observation with regions extracted by Mobile-SAM, either alone, supplemented with two interaction frames, or supplemented with both these frames and a 16 16 -frame interaction clip, as specified in Table 4 . We include ArtiPoint ( Werby et al., 2025 ) as a reference, noting that it requires the full RGB-D sequence, camera poses, and reference interaction cues, and OPDMulti, which reads a single RGB frame and is the only baseline trained on real indoor captures. From the static observation alone, ViewStruct correctly identifies the joint type in 69.3 % 69.3\% of prismatic and 77.2 % 77.2\% of revolute interactions. Adding the clip improves these accuracies by 16.7 16.7 and 15.8 15.8 percentage points, respectively, and reduces hinge-position error from 0.31 0.31 to 0.23 0.23 m. Under the same single-observation condition, ViewStruct exceeds OPDMulti on every column of Table 4 , by 17.1 17.1 and 5.2 5.2 points of type accuracy and by 0.11 0.11 m of hinge position. Together with the qualitative results in Figure 5 , these findings demonstrate transfer to real-world interactions despite task-specific training exclusively on synthetic data, without egocentric human-interaction examples during fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在没有额外训练的情况下，使用来自 Arti4D（Werby 等人，2025）的 342 次人类交互数据对 ViewStruct 进行了评估。 该模型接收一个初始的 RGB-D 观测数据，其中区域由 Mobile-SAM 提取；输入可以是单独使用该观测数据，也可以补充两个交互帧，或者同时补充这两个交互帧和一个 16 帧的交互片段，具体如表 4 所示。 我们将 ArtiPoint（Werby 等人，2025）作为参考模型，需要注意的是，它需要完整的 RGB-D 序列、相机姿态和参考交互提示；此外还有 OPDMulti，它仅读取单个 RGB 帧，是唯一在真实室内场景数据上训练的基线模型。 仅基于静态观测数据，ViewStruct 在 69.3% 的棱柱型交互和 77.2% 的旋转型交互中正确识别了关节类型。 加入交互片段后，这些准确率分别提升了 16.7 和 15.8 个百分点，并将铰链位置误差从 0.31 米降低到 0.23 米。 在相同的单次观测条件下，ViewStruct 在表 4 的每一列中都优于 OPDMulti：类型准确率分别高出 17.1 和 5.2 个百分点，铰链位置误差则减少了 0.11 米。 结合图 5 中的定性结果，这些发现表明，尽管模型仅在合成数据上进行任务特定训练，并且在微调阶段没有使用第一人称视角的人类交互示例，它仍然能够迁移到真实世界的交互场景中。

paragraphs.en: ViewStruct provides camera-relative articulation estimates that can guide robot motion from a single observation, without requiring a prior interaction demonstration. Its predicted axes, pivots, and ranges define candidate opening trajectories for doors and drawers.

paragraphs.en: We presented ViewStruct, a view-grounded framework for jointly predicting part connectivity and articulation in objects and scenes. By combining visual and semantic priors, ViewStruct performs direct autoregressive prediction without per-instance optimisation, inferring structure from a single static observation and incorporating motion evidence when available. Experiments demonstrate improved structural prediction over existing baselines, generalisation to unseen object categories and asset sources, and transfer from synthetic training data to real-world interaction videos. Simulated manipulation experiments further show that the predicted joints can guide effective interaction trajectories. These results highlight the potential of view-grounded structural inference for connecting visual observations to actionable representations of articulated environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ViewStruct，这是一个基于视图的框架，用于联合预测物体和场景中部件的连接性和关节活动。 通过结合视觉和语义先验知识，ViewStruct 能够直接进行自回归预测，无需对每个实例进行优化，仅从单次静态观察中推断结构，并在有可用运动证据时将其纳入考量。 实验表明，与现有基线方法相比，该框架在结构预测方面表现更优，能够泛化到未见过的物体类别和资产来源，并可将知识从合成训练数据迁移到真实世界的交互视频中。 模拟操作实验进一步证明，预测出的关节可以指导有效的交互轨迹。 这些结果凸显了基于视图的结构推断在将视觉观察与可操作的关节环境表示相连接方面的潜力。

paragraphs.en: Segmentation colours are permuted deterministically per asset, and part identifiers are randomly permuted during training, with the same permutation applied to the prompt and target. These operations reduce shortcuts based on colours or indices. Additional RGB views and clips retain the reference inventory and coordinate frame; they do not introduce independently indexed part lists.
paragraphs.zh: 分割颜色按资产进行确定性排列，而部件标识符在训练期间被随机排列，且相同的排列方式也应用于提示和目标。 这些操作减少了基于颜色或索引的捷径。 额外的 RGB 视图和片段保留了参考库存和坐标框架；它们不会引入独立索引的部件列表。

paragraphs.en: The output lists static regions in base and moving bodies in joints . Each joint entry contains its rigidly connected parts , a parent-body reference on , and its articulation parameters. The first region in a body is its anchor; in a moving body, that region carries the joint. The remaining regions attach rigidly to the anchor. Each part appears in exactly one body, and joints are ordered by moving-part box centre, from top to bottom and then left to right. This grouping avoids predicting every internal rigid attachment, while retaining a deterministic convention for expanding the parent map.
paragraphs.zh: 输出列出了基体中的静态区域和关节中的移动体。 每个关节条目都包含其刚性连接的部分、一个父体引用，以及其铰接参数。 一个体中的第一个区域是其锚点；在移动体中，该区域承载了关节。 其余区域以刚性方式连接到锚点。 每个部分仅出现在一个体中，而关节则根据移动部分的框中心进行排序，从上到下，然后从左到右。 这种分组方式避免了对每个内部刚性连接进行预测，同时保留了扩展父体映射的确定性约定。

paragraphs.en: The objects field groups region identifiers by object, with the static body listed first. A joint attached to base refers to its own object’s static body. The designated reference object defines the observation centre and scale, and all other objects share that frame. Object membership and body grouping therefore yield one hierarchy per object within a jointly generated scene structure, using direct autoregressive prediction without per-instance optimisation.
paragraphs.zh: 对象字段按对象对区域标识符进行分组，其中静态主体列于首位。 连接到基座的关节指的是其自身对象的静态主体。 指定的参考对象定义了观察中心和比例，所有其他对象都共享该坐标系。 因此，对象成员关系和主体分组在每个对象内生成一个层级结构，该结构位于联合生成的场景结构中，并通过直接自回归预测实现，无需针对每个实例进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Source meshes and joints are first converted to consistent coordinates and units. We place each asset at rest using forward kinematics, then render aligned RGB, part-ID, and depth images from one canonical and several sampled cameras. Each camera gives a separate static training example. Joint axes and pivots are transformed into the observation frame, and pivots are projected to obtain image-space targets. For motion examples, a clip actuates one joint while retaining the reference inventory and frame. Scene examples additionally record the membership of all annotated objects.
paragraphs.zh: 首先将源网格和关节转换为一致的坐标和单位。 我们使用正向运动学将每个资产置于静止状态，然后从一个标准相机和多个采样相机渲染对齐的 RGB、部件 ID 和深度图像。 每个相机提供一个独立的静态训练样本。 关节轴和枢轴被转换到观察坐标系中，并将枢轴投影以获得图像空间的目标。 对于运动样本，一个片段会驱动一个关节，同时保留参考库存和框架。 场景样本还会记录所有已标注对象的成员关系。

paragraphs.en: Fixed-joint chains are collapsed into rigid bodies before serialisation, retaining one articulated attachment per moving body. This prevents a handle fixed to a door, or two fragments of the same door, from receiving independent copies of the hinge. Meshless scaffold links are removed without discarding fixed attachments between physical parts.
paragraphs.zh: 固定关节链在序列化前会被折叠为刚体，每个活动体保留一个铰接连接点。 这样就能防止固定在门上的把手或同一扇门的两个碎片各自获得独立的铰链副本。 无网格脚手架的连接件会被移除，但物理部件之间的固定连接不会被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: To vary part granularity, split augmentation divides a selected articulated leaf part by a plane through its centroid, while merge augmentation combines sibling parts with compatible articulation. The segmentation is re-rendered and the grouped target rebuilt, so fragments moving together share one joint. These operations vary the decomposition while preserving its intended kinematics.
paragraphs.zh: 为了改变部件的粒度，分割增强操作通过选定关节叶部件的质心平面将其分割，而合并增强操作则将具有兼容关节的兄弟部件组合在一起。 分割结果会被重新渲染，分组后的目标也会被重建，这样协同移动的碎片将共享一个关节。 这些操作在保持预期运动学特性的同时，改变了分解方式。

paragraphs.en: Our training pool comprises PhysX-Mobility ( Cao et al., 2025 ) ( 1,633 1{,}633 objects, 13,064 13{,}064 views), its decomposition variants ( 4,561 4{,}561 variants, 36,488 36{,}488 views), PhysXNet ( Cao et al., 2025 ) ( 40,000 40{,}000 objects, 160,000 160{,}000 views), GRScenes ( Wang et al., 2024 ) objects ( 2,502 2{,}502 objects, 10,008 10{,}008 views), and 2,338 2{,}338 GRScenes room views. To balance source contributions, each epoch samples 50 % 50\% of the decomposition-variant pool and 40 % 40\% of the PhysXNet pool, while retaining all examples from the remaining sources. paragraphs.en: Zero-shot Qwen3-VL receives the same images, region descriptions, and output schema as ViewStruct. PhysX-Anything ( Cao et al., 2025 ) and PhysX-Omni ( Cao et al., 2026 ) infer joints from the image through their VLM stages; geometry generation is skipped, and reference meshes are used for association with the evaluation inventory, not as visual input to those stages. URDF-Anything+ ( Li et al., 2025 ) receives the image and a whole-object mesh assembled from reference parts. We use its released checkpoint without shell thickening, which removed articulated components in our tests. Particulate ( Li et al., 2026a ) receives the merged reference mesh without an image and predicts its own decomposition and joints. OPDMulti ( Sun et al., 2024 ) receives the reference RGB image alone and predicts a mask, motion type, axis, and origin per openable part; the released motion-state checkpoint additionally predicts the joint state, from which a motion range follows. Its masks are matched to our inventory by intersection over union against the reference segmentation, so no geometric re-binding is required, and its camera-frame axes and origins are mapped into the observation frame with the view pose. It receives no camera intrinsics, so its absolute depth follows its training camera: on the room renders the predicted pivot depth is 0.55 × 0.55\times the reference value, and we remove this single factor per view by placing the predicted origins at the object’s known distance, which raises scene success from 10.1 10.1 to 11.8 11.8 . On Arti4D, recorded with a camera close to its own, the same correction is harmful ( 0.42 → 0.53 0.42\rightarrow 0.53 m) and predictions are reported unmodified. SINGAPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) is evaluated on the 65 65 StorageFurniture objects supported by its category vocabulary. Of these, 52 52 overlap its training set. Particulate has 81 81 training-overlap objects among the 387 387 PhysX-Mobility test objects. These overlaps are marked in the detailed comparison and preclude treating those rows as fully held-out evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: Zero-shot Qwen3-VL 接收与 ViewStruct 相同的图像、区域描述和输出模式。 PhysX-Anything（Cao 等人，2025）和 PhysX-Omni（Cao 等人，2026）通过其 VLM 阶段从图像中推断关节；几何生成被跳过，并使用参考网格与评估库存进行关联，而非作为这些阶段的视觉输入。 URDF-Anything+（Li 等人，2025）接收图像以及由参考部件组装而成的完整物体网格。 我们使用其发布的检查点，该版本未进行外壳加厚处理，而在我们的测试中，这一处理移除了可活动组件。 Particulate（Li 等人，2026a）接收合并后的参考网格（不含图像），并预测自身的分解结构和关节。 OPDMulti（Sun 等人，2024）仅接收参考 RGB 图像，并为每个可开启部件预测掩码、运动类型、轴和原点；发布的运动状态检查点还额外预测关节状态，由此可推导出运动范围。 其掩码通过与参考分割进行交并比与我们的库存匹配，因此无需几何重新绑定；其相机坐标系的原点和轴通过视图姿态映射到观察坐标系中。 它未接收任何相机内参，因此其绝对深度遵循训练时使用的相机：在房间渲染中，预测的枢轴深度为参考值的 0.55 × 0.55\times；我们通过将预测原点置于物体的已知距离处，按视图移除这一单一因子，从而将场景成功率从 10.1 10.1 提升至 11.8 11.8。 在 Arti4D 上，由于录制时使用的相机与其自身相机相近，相同的修正反而产生了负面影响（0.42 → 0.53 0.42\rightarrow 0.53 m），因此预测结果未经修改地报告。 SINGAPO（Liu 等人，2025）在其类别词汇表所支持的 65 65 个 StorageFurniture 物体上进行评估。 其中，有 52 52 个物体与其训练集重叠。 Particulate 在 387 387 个 PhysX-Mobility 测试物体中，有 81 81 个与训练集重叠。 这些重叠已在详细比较中标出，因此不能将这些行视为完全独立的评估结果。

paragraphs.en: Unmatched predicted nodes retain distinct identifiers and count as false positives when they carry joints. This association is applied to every method that produces its own decomposition, and it matters: the reference identifiers are assigned in a shuffled order, so pairing predictions by identifier instead of geometry attaches each joint to a different part and penalises correct parameters. On PhysX-Mobility, geometric association raises articulation success from 74.7 74.7 to 81.6 81.6 for PhysX-Anything, 77.8 77.8 to 85.3 85.3 for PhysX-Omni, 46.3 46.3 to 68.2 68.2 for Particulate, and 8.6 8.6 to 14.0 14.0 for URDF-Anything+, and it reduces the mean pivot error of the first two by more than a factor of two. Repeated identical parts are where identifier pairing fails most clearly: on an oven with seven knobs, every predicted axis, pivot and range of PhysX-Omni is correct, yet each joint is attached to a neighbouring knob, giving zero successes before association and eight of eight after. These policies are part of the evaluation and do not assume identical decompositions across methods.
paragraphs.zh: 未匹配的预期节点会保留独立的标识符，当它们带有关节时，会被计为假阳性。 这种关联方法适用于所有会产生自身分解的方法，并且这一点至关重要：参考标识符是按随机顺序分配的，因此如果按标识符而非几何形状来配对预测结果，就会将每个关节连接到不同的部件，并导致正确参数受到惩罚。 在 PhysX-Mobility 测试中，几何关联使 PhysX-Anything 的关节连接成功率从 74.7% 提升至 81.6%，PhysX-Omni 从 77.8% 提升至 85.3%，Particulate 从 46.3% 提升至 68.2%，URDF-Anything+ 从 8.6% 提升至 14.0%；同时，前两种方法的平均枢轴误差降低了超过一半。 重复出现的相同部件是标识符配对失败最明显的情况：在一个带有七个旋钮的烤箱上，PhysX-Omni 预测的所有轴、枢轴和范围都是正确的，但每个关节都被错误地连接到相邻的旋钮上，导致关联前成功次数为零，关联后则达到八次中的八次。 这些策略是评估的一部分，并不假设不同方法之间会产生相同的分解结果。

paragraphs.en: Following the failure ordering of Le et al. (2024) , a matched joint is assigned to its first failed gate: type, axis, origin, then limit. The thresholds are 0.25 0.25 rad for the axis, 0.05 0.05 object-extent units for the hinge pivot, and 1.6057 1.6057 for the difference between range spans (radians for hinges; the scorer uses the same numerical threshold in normalised displacement units for slides). Slides skip the origin gate. Matched-joint success is the fraction passing all gates. The scene table also divides successful matches by all reference joints in the scored rows, counting unmatched joints as failures; parse failures remain separately reported. Manipulation uses its own all-reference-joint denominator, including missing predictions as failures.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Le 等人（2024）提出的故障排序方法，一个匹配关节会被分配给其第一个未通过的关卡：类型、轴、原点，最后是极限。阈值分别为：轴为 0.25 0.25 弧度，铰链枢轴为 0.05 0.05 对象范围单位，以及范围跨度之间的差值为 1.6057 1.6057（铰链使用弧度；评分器对滑动关节则使用相同的数值阈值，但以归一化位移单位为度量）。滑动关节跳过原点关卡。匹配关节的成功率是指通过所有关卡的关节所占的比例。场景表还将成功匹配的关节数除以评分行中所有参考关节的总数，未匹配的关节计为失败；解析失败则单独报告。操作部分使用其自身的全参考关节分母，并将缺失的预测也计为失败。

paragraphs.en: All methods are timed sequentially on a dedicated A100-40GB using the same three objects, selected at the 25 25 th, 50 50 th, and 75 75 th percentiles of part count among 343 343 commonly runnable objects (two, three, and six parts). One-off loading is excluded for ViewStruct, PhysX-Anything, and PhysX-Omni, which retain their models in memory. Loading is included for URDF-Anything+ and Particulate, which launch a process per object. paragraphs.en: Replacing the gravity-aligned frame of Equation 3 with the raw camera frame, leaving the origin and unit length unchanged, costs 3.9 3.9 points of articulation success. The loss is concentrated in the axis channel ( 89.9 → 86.6 89.9\rightarrow 86.6 ) and in the success rate that depends on it, while joint presence is unchanged ( 96.8 → 96.9 96.8\rightarrow 96.9 ) and the hinge pivot is unaffected ( 0.084 → 0.082 0.084\rightarrow 0.082 ). This is the expected pattern: pivots are read off the image and do not depend on the 3D convention, whereas an axis expressed in camera coordinates changes with the camera’s pitch and roll, so the same vertical hinge takes a different target value in every view and the model must absorb that variance. Aligning one axis of the frame with gravity removes it for the vertical hinges that dominate the corpus; horizontal directions remain view-dependent in both frames.
paragraphs.zh: 将方程3中与重力对齐的坐标系替换为原始相机坐标系，同时保持原点和单位长度不变，会损失3.9个关节活动度成功分数。 损失主要集中在轴通道（89.9 → 86.6）以及依赖该通道的成功率上，而关节存在性保持不变（96.8 → 96.9），铰链枢轴也未受影响（0.084 → 0.082）。 这是符合预期的模式：枢轴是从图像中直接读取的，不依赖于三维坐标系约定；而用相机坐标表示的轴则会随相机的俯仰和偏航变化，因此同一个垂直铰链在不同视角下会对应不同的目标值，模型必须吸收这种差异。 将坐标系的一条轴与重力对齐，可以消除该轴对语料库中占主导地位的垂直铰链的影响；而在两种坐标系中，水平方向仍然依赖于视角。

paragraphs.en: Removing the split-merge rows, which vary the supplied part granularity while preserving the intended kinematics, measures how much of the model’s robustness comes from having seen alternative decompositions of the same object rather than from the object inventory itself. It is the larger of the two effects: articulation success drops by 10.0 10.0 points ( 81.5 → 71.5 81.5\rightarrow 71.5 ) although the same objects and views remain in the training set. The joints are still found ( 96.8 → 96.2 96.8\rightarrow 96.2 presence), but their parameters degrade across every channel, the axis most ( 89.9 → 82.8 89.9\rightarrow 82.8 ), followed by the motion range ( 72.3 → 66.3 72.3\rightarrow 66.3 ) and the hinge pivot ( 0.084 → 0.096 0.084\rightarrow 0.096 ). Grouping is also weaker ( 92.3 → 88.6 92.3\rightarrow 88.6 parent), which is what the augmentation targets directly: without rows in which a part is split or two parts are merged, the model associates a particular segmentation of an object with a particular answer instead of inferring which supplied regions move together.
paragraphs.zh: 移除拆分-合并行后，这些行会改变所提供的部件粒度，同时保持预期的运动学特性，从而衡量模型鲁棒性中有多少源于见过同一对象的不同分解方式，而非源于对象本身。 这是两种影响中较大的一种：关节活动成功率下降了 10.0 分（81.5 → 71.5），尽管训练集中仍然包含相同的对象和视图。 关节仍然能够被识别（存在率 96.8 → 96.2），但其参数在所有通道上均出现退化，其中轴心参数下降最明显（89.9 → 82.8），其次是运动范围（72.3 → 66.3）和铰链枢轴（0.084 → 0.096）。 分组能力也较弱了（父节点准确率 92.3 → 88.6），而这正是增强策略直接针对的目标：在没有部件被拆分或两个部件被合并的行时，模型会将对象的特定分割与特定答案直接关联，而不是推断哪些提供的区域会协同移动。

paragraphs.en: The model receives no numerical gravity: c c , s s and the depth intervals of Equation 6 are read from the silhouette and the depth map, and the prompt describes the frame only in words. Gravity therefore enters at a single point, when the output is interpreted, so an inertial sensor that is wrong by δ \delta is exactly equivalent to rotating every predicted axis and pivot by δ \delta before comparing them with the reference. We apply that rotation about a random horizontal axis, per object, and rescore; no retraining is involved. Table 8 shows the result. Errors up to 2 ∘ 2^{\circ} are free, 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} costs 1.7 1.7 points, and the degradation becomes severe only as δ \delta approaches the 14.3 ∘ 14.3^{\circ} axis threshold, which it then consumes. An inertial sensor is an order of magnitude more accurate than that, and monocular gravity estimators sit near 2 2 – 3 ∘ 3^{\circ} ; joint type, which does not depend on the frame, is unaffected throughout.

paragraphs.en: We reconstruct each object in PyBullet using its reference joints and limits, with a fixed base, gravity disabled, and no joint motors. A compliant gripper is represented by a force-bounded point constraint attached at a supplied contact location: the mesh point farthest from the reference axis for a hinge, or the moving part’s centre for a slide. These privileged contacts and simplified physics isolate articulation prediction quality; grasp discovery and collision avoidance are not evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 PyBullet 中利用参考关节和关节限位来重建每个物体，并设置固定基座、禁用重力且不使用任何关节电机。 一个柔顺夹具由一个力受限的点约束表示，该约束附着在指定的接触位置：对于铰链，该位置是网格点中距离参考轴最远的点；对于滑动关节，则是活动部分的中心。 这些特权接触点和简化的物理模型使关节运动预测的质量得以独立评估；抓握识别和碰撞避免则不在评估范围内。

paragraphs.en: The gripper follows the predicted joint associated with the contacted part. For a hinge, it traces a 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} arc around the predicted axis and pivot. paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 12 , direction reversal increases ViewStruct’s hinge success from 56.7 % 56.7\% to 74.1 % 74.1\% . Among 217 217 initial hinge failures, 169 169 exhibit no motion; the reverse-direction retry recovers 94 94 failures. These results highlight a limitation of sign-invariant axis metrics: successful execution also depends on the motion direction specified by the axis and joint interval. Pivot errors can further cause the commanded trajectory to conflict with the reference mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 12 所示，方向反转将 ViewStruct 的铰链成功率从 56.7% 提升至 74.1%。 在 217 个初始铰链故障中，有 169 个未出现任何运动；反向重试恢复了其中 94 个故障。 这些结果凸显了符号不变轴度量的一个局限性：成功执行还取决于轴和关节区间所指定的运动方向。 枢轴错误还可能进一步导致指令轨迹与参考机构发生冲突。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate a Panda arm in MuJoCo over ten trials in ten GRScenes rooms. The arm follows trajectories derived from ViewStruct’s predictions, while each object retains its reference mechanism. A compliant point constraint provides assisted contact, robot–scene collisions are disabled, and foreground geometry is cut away for visibility. Eight trials reach the opening threshold. This evaluation assesses trajectory execution under assisted contact; it does not evaluate collision-free planning or autonomous grasp acquisition.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MuJoCo 中，于十个 GRScenes 房间内，通过十次试验对 Panda 机械臂进行评估。 该机械臂遵循由 ViewStruct 预测生成的轨迹，同时每个物体都保留其参考机制。 一个柔顺点约束提供了辅助接触，机器人与场景的碰撞被禁用，并且前景几何体被切除以确保可见性。 八次试验达到了开启阈值。 本次评估旨在检验辅助接触下的轨迹执行能力；它并不评估无碰撞规划或自主抓取获取能力。

paragraphs.en: Figure 10 shows successful openings of a window ( 39 ∘ 39^{\circ} ), cabinet door ( 49 ∘ 49^{\circ} ), room door ( 40 ∘ 40^{\circ} ), and microwave door ( 32 ∘ 32^{\circ} ). In the two unsuccessful trials, the TV-stand drawer stops 3 3 cm short of its threshold, while the shoe cabinet remains stationary because the predicted sliding direction points into the reference joint limit. These cases illustrate how insufficient travel and incorrect motion direction can prevent opening even when the unsigned axis is plausible.

paragraphs.en: ViewStruct relies on a supplied part decomposition: missing parts or regions spanning independently moving bodies can prevent correct structural recovery. Geometric accuracy also depends on depth, camera calibration, gravity estimation, and consistent part association across observations. Our current image-based experiments additionally supply the joint count; estimating it jointly with structure would relax this assumption. Even with accurate inputs, static observations may not uniquely determine hidden pivots, opening directions, or mechanical limits. Additional views and motion evidence can reduce these ambiguities, motivating future work on uncertainty estimation and active observation selection.
paragraphs.zh: ViewStruct 依赖于所提供的部件分解：缺失的部件或跨越独立移动物体的区域可能会妨碍正确的结构恢复。 几何准确性还取决于深度、相机校准、重力估计以及跨观察视角的一致性部件关联。 我们当前的基于图像的实验还额外提供了关节数量；若能与结构一同估计该参数，即可放宽这一假设。 即使输入准确，静态观察也可能无法唯一确定隐藏的枢轴、开启方向或机械限制。 更多的视角和运动证据可以减少这些不确定性，这为未来在不确定性估计和主动观察选择方面的工作提供了动力。

paragraphs.en: Computational constraints restrict our experiments to a 4B-parameter VLM and a finite collection of articulated assets. Although the model transfers to unseen categories and real-world interactions, its task-specific training uses exclusively synthetic data, leaving a domain gap in appearance, segmentation quality, and depth accuracy. Larger backbones and more diverse training observations may improve robustness, although their benefits must be balanced against inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 计算限制将我们的实验限定在参数规模为4B的VLM以及有限数量的结构化资产集合上。 尽管该模型能够迁移到未见过的类别和现实世界中的交互，但其任务特定训练完全依赖合成数据，导致在外观、分割质量和深度准确性方面存在领域差异。 使用更大的主干网络和更多样化的训练观察数据或许能提升模型的鲁棒性，但需权衡其带来的收益与推理成本。

paragraphs.en: Inference takes a few seconds, making ViewStruct suitable for initial structure estimation and high-level planning, while faster updates would be needed for continuous feedback control. Our manipulation evaluation uses supplied contact locations and simplified physics, and does not assess autonomous grasp selection, collision avoidance, or physical-property estimation. Future work could initialise an interaction loop with ViewStruct, track part motion during contact, and refine joint parameters before replanning. Geometric fitting could provide these updates without retraining the predictor.
paragraphs.zh: 推理过程只需几秒钟，这使得 ViewStruct 适用于初步结构估计和高层规划，但若要实现持续反馈控制，则需要更快的更新速度。 我们的操控评估使用了提供的接触位置和简化的物理模型，并未对自主抓握选择、避障或物理属性估计进行评估。 未来的工作可以利用 ViewStruct 初始化交互循环，在接触过程中跟踪部件运动，并在重新规划前优化关节参数。 几何拟合无需重新训练预测模型即可提供这些更新。
